content: {"reasoning":"CO-97 is a bundling denial, not an authorization issue, and the patient has no contractual cost share to bill. Although prior appeals and peer-to-peer review have not resolved this claim, the published rules do not establish that further appeal rights are exhausted. Among applicable rework actions, similar claims favor a necessity appeal (1/1 paid) over another peer-to-peer review (1/3 paid), with strong clinic documentation available to support the appeal.","action":"appeal_with_necessity"}
